competing_explanation: A raw policy can appear useful because of privileged target leakage, tile pseudoreplication, scene-specific overfit, or uncontrolled multiplicity; conversely, full abstention can be caused by weak observable signal, utility correction, risk correction, their interaction, or a genuine utility-risk conflict.

for P00 in OOF and test-development separately, simultaneous Wilson UCB is at most 0.10 for PSNR, SSIM, and color harm; unsafe requires an LCB above 0.10

fixed_factors: official ConvIR-B base backbone, Haze4K checkpoint, and 104-channel observable representation remain frozen
one shared Conv2d 104-to-64-to-64-to-4 head is trained once per fold and once for secondary stress; policies never receive separate training
actions remain keep 1.0, weaken 0.8, and strengthen 1.2
training remains 12 epochs with AdamW 0.0003, weight decay 0.0001, gradient clipping 1.0, utility Huber beta 0.25, risk weight 0.5, and positive weight 2.0
calibration remains the finite-sample 95 percent upper quantile of nonnegative scene-mean utility and risk residuals
utility margin remains 0.05 dB, risk acceptance remains 0.10, and formal precision remains 0.025 dB
P00, P10, P01, and P11 share every raw prediction, image, target, correction, and action set
original clear scene is the only independent analysis unit
bootstrap resamples within each OOF fold and combines the five fold means equally
haze variants, tiles, actions, folds, pixels, and bootstrap draws never increase sample size
the 150 calibration scenes are nuisance-only and the 100 test-development scenes are historical secondary stress only
candidate-confirmation, NH-Haze, ITS, and OTS remain unread
intervention.matched_budget: one outcome-blind haze variant for each of 600 OOF scenes and 150 fixed calibration scenes; all four variants averaged within each of 100 secondary test-development scenes
intervention.primary_variable: four predeclared raw-versus-corrected policies sharing one frozen observable utility-risk predictor
intervention.reference: official keep output, same-predictor image-uniform action, within-image shuffled action map, P11 historical mechanism, and GT-privileged positive control

primary_estimand.aggregation: five-fold OOF mean over 600 original-clear scenes, one outcome-blind selected haze variant per scene, with fold-stratified paired bootstrap

question: Does the frozen shared observable predictor contain safe and material raw OOF action signal that is specifically suppressed by the archived calibration interface, or is the raw signal itself insufficient under the frozen representation and learner?
